candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method only sets the new password and updates the user. It never deletes the user's existing sessions (for example with sessionService.deleteByUserId). Sessions created before the reset stay valid, so an already signed-in device can still call refreshToken (updateByHash finds its session) and keep renewing its login.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }). Every device is then signed out and its refresh token stops working.
